questions.question: What is the fixed annual interest coupon paid on Sovereign Gold Bonds?
questions.explanation: RBI Sovereign Gold Bonds pay a fixed 2.50% annual interest on the initial nominal issue price, credited semi-annually.

questions.question: What is the full maturity period of a Sovereign Gold Bond?
questions.explanation: SGBs have a total tenure of 8 years, with early redemption options offered by RBI starting from the 5th year on coupon payment dates.

questions.question: Under Section 47(viic) of the Income Tax Act, how are capital gains on SGB redemption at 8-year maturity taxed for individuals?
questions.explanation: Section 47(viic) explicitly exempts individual investors from capital gains tax upon redemption of SGBs at maturity through RBI.

questions.question: How is the redemption price of SGB calculated upon maturity?
options: Fixed at the original purchase price plus ₹500
Based on the simple average closing price of 999 purity gold over the preceding 3 business days published by IBJA
Decided randomly by the finance minister
Tied to the US Dollar exchange rate only
questions.explanation: Redemption value is linked directly to prevailing 24k gold market prices published by the India Bullion and Jewellers Association (IBJA).

questions.question: Does SGB protect an investor if global gold prices drop over the 8-year period?
options: Yes, the government guarantees a minimum 10% gain even if gold drops
No, SGB guarantees the quantity of gold, not a fixed rupee price. If gold falls, redemption value is lower
Yes, the investor receives physical silver instead
Yes, the bond automatically converts into government shares
questions.explanation: SGB eliminates storage and purity risk, but the investor remains exposed to gold market price volatility.
